blurb: Cross Creek is a gated residential community on 122 wooded acres in Buckhead, Atlanta. Residents enjoy an 18-hole par-three golf course, tennis and pickleball courts, three swimming pools, a fitness center, and a café. The community offers additional conveniences such as electric vehicle charging stations, rentable storage units, and 24-hour gate attendants.
extraNote: HOA dues cover water & sewage, termite bond, hazard insurance, exterior maintenance, lighting, trash pickup, landscaping, and recreation maintenance · Parking is first-come, first-served except assigned covered spaces; two spaces per unit allowed · Poolhouses at Adrian and LaRue may be reserved by residents for private events via management office or Resident Portal · Late HOA payments incur 10% late fee and 8% annual interest; suspension of access devices possible · Pools open seasonally from Memorial Day through Labor Day
